text:
dev-bot: INCIDENT ALERT @channel — Catalyst (enterprise, VPC) reports elevated 5xx and 504 rates from their dedicated pool. Severity: sev2. Detected spike at 17:03 UTC. TraceID sample: 0a1b2c... Links: https://grafana/redwood/catalyst/pool-ops

emma.oncall: oncall ack — I'm taking this. Paging raj.sre and marta.eng. First check: are any hosts OOM or GPU oversubscribed?

raj.sre: ack. pulling metrics. I see RX/TX stable, but tail latency up for seq>1024. KV cache miss rate increased 4x. Could be noisy tenant. Starting tenant isolation runbook.

marta.eng: joining. Confirm model variant autoswitch didn't kick. Checking router logs — some requests routed to fallback-small-quantized; error rate unchanged. Will run `rtdb get pool:catalyst:tenants` and `rtdb exec isolate-tenant --id=cust-431`.

linh.custops: looped in customer success. Catalyst on enterprise plan, SLA 99.9%. They're seeing failures in billing flow. Preparing to notify them after initial mitigation. Do we need an interim customer-facing note?

raj.sre: isolation command ran, evicted tenant cust-431 from pool. Observe metrics: tail latency dropping. P50 unchanged. 504s down by ~70% in last 3 min.

emma.oncall: good. keep running for 15m. rehydrate cache for remaining tenants: `cachectl prewarm --pool catalyst --scope global`.

marta.eng: prewarm started. Also increasing per-tenant qps cap for remaining tenants to avoid cascades: `routectl set-rate --pool catalyst --tenant * --qps 20` (temp)

oliver.researcher: shared a quick log snippet: 
```
2026-03-15T17:02:58Z model-infer kernel-queue-time: 120ms
2026-03-15T17:03:12Z kv-cache miss for tenant=cust-431
2026-03-15T17:03:36Z grpc: upstream error: EOF
```

linh.custops: Catalyst wants an immediate status note. Drafting: "We temporarily isolated one tenant to restore service; no customer data was affected; team is running full RCA." Will share after ops confirms stabilization.

emma.oncall: confirmed stabilization at 17:18 UTC. Preparing pager handoff to night oncall. @raj can you produce short RCA draft and impact calc (minutes of downtime, SLA credit estimate)?

raj.sre: will draft RCA in #eng-postmortems. Preliminary cause: noisy tenant with large sequence-length burst causing KV-cache churn + kernel stall on a subset of GPU hosts. Next steps: tenant-level hard qps caps, improve cache prewarm heuristics, kernel watchdog.

marta.eng: engineering will schedule a patch to add kernel-level backpressure and better cache eviction policy. ETA for fix: 2-3 sprints. I will add a hotfix checklist: emergency kernel restart playbook and an automated tenant-eviction run.

linh.custops: Catalyst asked about credits. Estimate: 12 minutes degraded, affecting 5% of calls. I'll pull billing numbers and propose partial credit under SLA. Will coordinate wording with finance.

emma.oncall: action items:
- raj: RCA draft + impact numbers (due EOD)
- marta: hotfix PR + rollout plan (due next week)
- linh: customer note + credit estimate (sync w/ finance)
- oncall: schedule post-incident review meeting (2d)

marta.eng: +1. I will also prepare a concise exec summary for AM ops and customer execs.

dev-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — severity reduced to monitoring. If no regressions within 60m, mark as mitigated.

linh.custops: shared customer note draft for review: "We isolated a noisy tenant and applied mitigations; service restored; next steps include RCA and timeline for permanent fix. We will follow up with a credit proposal. Contact: linh@redwood.com" — comments?

raj.sre: looks good, suggest adding exact times and that no data exfiltration occurred.

emma.oncall: final ack. I'll close the live bridge and hand to followup thread. Great work team. :tada:
